fixes.explanation: Right, friend! Moses says you may eat your fill of grapes, but you "…must not put any in your basket." (Deuteronomy 23:24). Eat all you want, right there in the vineyard. The basket is where the answer turns into NO. I've had a few cookies in my day that I stuffed in my apron when nobody was looking, so I know that basket feeling. You caught the one rule that says no, baker.

problems.problem: The explanation is flat and repetitive, restating the basket rule without Papa Dorin’s distinctive voice.
